items.prompt: Portrait of The Mending Choir, a Chorus bio-swarm admiral in the form of a Living Suture-Hive: a pulsing biological cocoon-graft, clusters of translucent amber nursing sacs glowing from within, curved pale chitin bone-needles growing out of the flesh and stitching glowing pink membrane webbing across a shattered dark carapace, fresh pink scar tissue knitting the cracks closed, new flesh visibly regrowing over old wounds. It is an alien grown organism, not a person and not an animal: no face, no eyes, no mouth with teeth, no limbs, no human features; no buildings, no machines, no instruments, no architecture. Glistening wet flesh, membrane, chitin, bile, gross deep-sea biology.
